name: Add a plugin-provided Guidelines skill
query: My plugin currently stores a transcription prompt in an option. Move it to a WordPress Guidelines skill so the site agent and other clients can discover it, but do not overwrite edits after setup.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router and wp-project-triage to classify the repo and locate the plugin entrypoint
Step 2: Route to wp-guideline because the task mentions WordPress Guidelines, agent-discoverable skill storage, and wp_guideline behavior
Step 3: Confirm the target runtime exposes wp_guideline, wp_guideline_type, and /wp/v2/guidelines or add an explicit graceful fallback
Step 4: Choose the skill type rather than content, artifact, memory, plan, or instruction
Step 5: Resolve or create the wp_guideline_type term by slug and assign by term id
Step 6: Create or update a wp_guideline post with stable slug, title, excerpt, content, status, and type term
Step 7: Preserve user edits after setup by using an idempotent seeding strategy such as a plugin-specific seed hash
Step 8: Keep site-wide publish behavior behind an administrator-controlled setup path
Step 9: Verify REST discovery through /wp/v2/guidelines and permission behavior for private/published rows
success_criteria: Uses wp_guideline rather than a plugin-private CPT or option for the agent skill
Uses wp_guideline_type with a resolved term id
Stores the short discovery text in excerpt and full procedure in content
Does not clobber user-edited guideline content on later runs
Respects WordPress capabilities and authenticated REST behavior
Mentions graceful degradation when Guidelines are not available
